review.notes: Full review. Seeded sample 1.1, 1.2, 1.3, 2.1, 2.2, 3.1, 3.2, 3.3: every statement and every numerical Check recomputed with exact rational arithmetic; the bounds of 1.2, 2.1 and 2.2 tested on 341 random chains with a finite mixing time (every start, burn-in up to 3, length up to 4); no failure. Source locators checked in the text: Rudolf arXiv:1108.3201v2 (Theorems 2.20 and 3.34), Flegal-Jones arXiv:0811.1729v5 (pp. 2, 7, 8, 9), Levin-Peres 2nd ed. p. 178, Aldous-Fill (2.6); Fan-Jiang-Sun read only in arXiv:1802.00211v4, so its JMLR theorem numbers and pages are not verified. 27 library declarations opened at the pins; supplier citations resolved on main (MarkovChainMixing, MarkovChainsAndRenewal, MathematicalStatisticsFoundations, RandomMatrices) and at the open heads of MCMCAsymptoticVariance and MartingaleCentralLimitTheorem; the eight copied definitions agree with their owners. Automatic checks all passed; dependency check 0 problems; Suggested.lean elaborates with sorry as the only warning; one-tactic probe closes none of the 8 theorems; elaborated signatures compared with the README. Two small corrections (pointers into MarkovChainMixing 1.2 and MCMCAsymptoticVariance 2.1), two format notes; scope question (targets marked 'proved here') left to the human reviewers.
